newsitem.title: USA: ENStar to offer up to 600,000 shares.
newsitem.headline: ENStar to offer up to 600,000 shares.

text.p: ENStar Inc, a holding company, said Tuesday its board of directors has authorized a modified Dutch Auction self-tender offer for up to 600,000 shares of ENStar's common stock.
The tender price range will be $4.75 to $6.25 per share, the company said.

The offer is expected to commence during the week of June 24, 1997, with the distribution of the offering materials, and will be subject to the terms and conditions therein. The offer is expected to expire at on July 25, 1997, unless extended, the compnay said.
As of June 17, 1997, ENStar had 3.3 million shares of common stock outstanding.
